header.one_line: Rajasthan, across the Thar desert from Jaipur to the border posts beyond Jaisalmer

rules.title: Bawliyanwala border point: online pass is mandatory
rules.detail: Every adult needs an individual pass, booked online on the Tanot temple trust website, to go past Tanot to the border viewing point. Notice on the issuer's site.
rules.set_by: Border Security Force, through the Shri Tanot Mata Mandir Trust

history.change: Border Security Force announced a visitor stadium and retreat ceremony at the Babliyan post; visitor rules were still to be decided.

source.title: BSF to start Beating Retreat along international border in Rajasthan by March

history.change: Online pass launched for Indian nationals. Before this, visitors registered with identity papers at a counter at Tanot temple.

source.title: Rajasthan: BSF Launches E-Pass Facility For Tourists Visiting India-Pakistan Border In Jaisalmer

history.change: Online booking of the border pass became mandatory.

rules.title: Tanot and Longewala: no permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Indian visitors reach Tanot temple and the Longewala war memorial without a permit. Stated by a tour operator; no government order was found.
rules.set_by: Border Security Force (practice on the ground)

source.title: Jaisalmer Indo Pak Border: Longewala and Tanot Guide 2026

rules.title: Longewala to Tanot: identity checked at a checkpost
rules.detail: A traveller's account says a checkpost between Longewala and Tanot asks for identity papers and turns back anyone without valid ones. No government order was found.

source.title: Longewala War Memorial - The pride of India

rules.title: Foreign nationals: prior permission for Tanot and Longewala
rules.detail: A tour operator says foreigners must apply at least 15 days ahead through the District Collector's office in Jaisalmer. No government order was found.

source.title: Jaisalmer Indo Pak Border: Longewala and Tanot Guide 2026

rules.title: Border pillar beyond Tanot: separate written permission
rules.detail: A 2017 rider account: form from the Jaisalmer Collector's office, then approval at a Border Security Force office on the Tanot road. No government order found; may be outdated.
rules.set_by: District Collector, Jaisalmer, and Border Security Force (as reported)

season.note: Riders go between October and February; April to June is avoided because desert temperatures pass 45 degrees Celsius.

authorities.office: Border Security Force, through the Shri Tanot Mata Mandir Trust
authorities.announces: Issues the Bawliyanwala border pass and posts temple notices
authorities.stretch: Tanot to the Bawliyanwala border point

source.title: Rajasthan: BSF Launches E-Pass Facility For Tourists Visiting India-Pakistan Border In Jaisalmer

authorities.announces: Reported to issue the form for border pillar visits and permission for foreign nationals

hazards.title: Extreme summer heat in the Thar
hazards.detail: Daytime temperatures pass 45 degrees Celsius; an operator advises against the border loop in these months.

source.title: Jaisalmer Indo Pak Border: Longewala and Tanot Guide 2026

hazards.title: Few fuel pumps beyond Jaisalmer
hazards.detail: Pumps are rare on the Ramgarh, Tanot and Longewala loop; fill up in Jaisalmer before leaving.

source.title: Jaisalmer Indo Pak Border: Longewala and Tanot Guide 2026

gaps: No government page was found that states the permit rule for Tanot and Longewala. The Rajasthan tourism site loads its text by script and could not be read.
The fee for the Bawliyanwala border pass, the visiting hours at the border point, and whether motorcycles may ride to it are not stated on the pages read.
The 2017 account of border pillar permission could not be checked against a newer source; the rider who wrote it did not know if motorcycles were allowed.
Usual number of riding days: no source found.
No highest point recorded: this is a desert route, not a hill route.
The highway value combines three Wikipedia pages (National Highway 125, 11 and 70); only one is cited. The Jaipur to Jodhpur highway number was not sourced.
No source found for winter fog on this route.
Videos: the pages give upload dates, not filming dates, so 'filmed' is filled only where the title names a date. Uploads, in order: 2024-12, 2020-02.
